high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "thecosmologicalway." The post is part of a series, as indicated by the "3/4" in the top right corner, suggesting there are four parts to this content. Visual Elements: The main visual is a diagram illustrating the concept of gravity according to General Relativity. It shows a curved grid representing spacetime, with a blue sphere (Earth) and a smaller gray sphere (Moon) placed on it. A wavy line connects the Earth and Moon, symbolizing the gravitational force
